items.title: Houthi pipeline claim and U.S. Qeshm retaliation deepen Gulf export risk
items.summary: Houthis claim they launched five drones at two Saudi East-West pipeline pumping stations, but Saudi authorities have not confirmed damage or interrupted flows. Separately, AP reports a U.S. official acknowledged a strike on an Iranian missile site on Qeshm Island after Iranian drones targeted Bahrain. Crude prices rose intraday, while verified new export losses remain absent.

observations.label: Reported November 17 pipeline threat
observations.value: Houthis claim five drones toward two Saudi East-West pipeline pumping stations; no Saudi damage or flow confirmation (Reuters)

observations.label: Pipeline exposure
observations.value: Approximately 4 million barrels/day rerouted to Yanbu via East-West pipeline, around 4% of global supply (Reuters)

observations.label: U.S. retaliation verification
observations.value: AP cites U.S. official confirming strike on IRGC missile-launch site on Qeshm Island; local official reported no civilian or infrastructure damage

observations.label: Next checks and invalidation
observations.value: Saudi ministry, operator and pipeline throughput confirmation, Yanbu loadings, tanker insurance, UKMTO/MARAD and Brent/WTI/XLE/XOP; uninterrupted flow weakens disruption thesis

items.key_finding: Gulf escalation now reaches a critical Saudi oil bypass route, but new physical supply loss is unverified.

sources.title: Reuters: Houthis say drones launched toward Saudi East-West pipeline
AP: U.S. source confirms Qeshm retaliation
Reuters: November 17 1:48 PM EST crude prices

items.title: NSA attributes classified-network disruption to maintenance as US equities tumble
items.summary: NSA acknowledged temporary internal-system degradation during routine maintenance and said mission-critical operations remained functional. CBS verified a classified network outage and reported no evidence of cyberattack. U.S. equities were sharply lower around 3:02 PM ET, but the outage has not been shown to cause the broader selloff.

observations.label: Official agency status November 17
observations.value: Temporary degradation during scheduled routine maintenance; mission-critical capabilities operational (NSA)

observations.label: Independent reporting November 17
observations.value: Classified NSA Net interruption, staggered employee arrivals, no evidence of malicious attack (CBS, updated 2:40 PM EST)

observations.label: 3:02 PM EST intraday market snapshot
observations.value: Dow down more than 1,000 points (~2%); S&P 500 -1.6%; Nasdaq -1.5% (MarketWatch); not settlement

observations.label: Next checks and invalidation
observations.value: NSA restoration notice, root-cause and patching details, correlation to other systems, QQQ/IGV breadth and Nvidia guidance; routine recovery limits systemic risk interpretation

items.key_finding: An officially acknowledged NSA maintenance incident coincided with broad selling; no cyberattack or market causality established.

sources.title: NSA official statement on network issues
CBS News NSA Net outage, updated November 17

items.title: Energizer rises against market selloff on better margins and cash-flow guidance
items.summary: Energizer rose sharply in afternoon trading following fiscal fourth-quarter results showing improved profitability and debt reduction. Management projects higher free cash flow next fiscal year even with soft organic sales. Elevated leverage and limited revenue growth remain important risks.

observations.label: Fiscal 2026 Q4 earnings
observations.value: Adjusted EPS $1.37 (+30% YoY); adjusted gross margin 42.5% (+400 basis points); quarterly free cash flow $123.6M

observations.label: Fiscal 2027 free cash flow projection
observations.value: Approximately $300M, up more than 30% from $228.6M fiscal 2026

observations.label: Risks and next indicators
observations.value: Organic sales down 0.6% in quarter; net debt/adjusted EBITDA 5.1x; watch organic growth, gross margin, debt reduction and free cash flow execution

items.key_finding: Stronger cash flow and margin execution distinguish Energizer from broad-market weakness despite elevated leverage.

items.title: Kerch Bridge collapse threatens deep-water shipping route into Sea of Azov
items.summary: Russia acknowledged bridge damage and suspended traffic after Ukrainian strikes on November 17. Photographs and multiple reports indicate a road arch fell into the Kerch Strait's navigable channel, raising risks to merchant shipping and regional freight. Exact vessel delays or complete closure of the waterway have not been verified independently.

observations.label: November 17 physical-infrastructure reports
observations.value: Approximately 227-m road-arch span reported collapsed; Russian officials confirm bridge damage and traffic restrictions; not a vessel-flow measurement

observations.label: Navigation channel
observations.value: Kerch-Yenikale deep-water route approximately 120 m wide; media and maritime observers say debris appears to obstruct it, without verified transit counts

observations.label: Next indicators and invalidation
observations.value: Official channel closure notices, vessel tracking, Sea of Azov port exports, grain/fuel freight rates, debris clearance; restored large-vessel passage would weaken impact thesis

items.key_finding: Corroborated structural loss creates credible shipping disruption risk, while quantified physical cargo-flow losses remain unverified.

items.title: AECOM rises sharply on record $28 billion infrastructure backlog and stronger margins
items.summary: AECOM gained about 8.5% in a November 17 intraday snapshot after reporting record backlog and higher adjusted margins. Fiscal fourth-quarter adjusted EPS increased despite a reported revenue decline. The main risk is cash consumption and cost overruns from two legacy construction-management projects.

observations.label: November 17 10:50 AM EST intraday snapshot
observations.value: ACM +8.5%; not a closing price, later return not independently timestamped

observations.label: November 16 fiscal Q4 results
observations.value: Total backlog $28.016B, +13% YoY; adjusted EPS $1.63, +20% YoY; adjusted EBITDA margin 19.2%, +170 bps; GAAP revenue -7%

observations.label: Cash-flow and next checks
observations.value: Q4 FCF $274M; expected ~$500M cash use in fiscal 2027 from two construction-management projects; monitor backlog conversion, margins, overruns

items.key_finding: Infrastructure earnings strength diverges from broad market weakness, but contract conversion and project cash costs remain essential tests.
